title: Canonical Pose Graph Payload (P3)
description: Backend-independent pose-graph payload stored in CAS. Contains graph nodes (timestamps + frame references) and edges (relative transforms + information matrices). Every pose-graph backend (GTSAM, g2o, custom) reads and writes this format through its adapter. The graph metadata (status, edge counts, aggregate provenance) lives in the MetadataDb row, not this payload.

graph_id.description: Instance-scoped UUIDv4 identity matching the MetadataDb pose_graphs row.

trajectory_id.description: The trajectory this pose graph was built from.

nodes.description: Pose graph nodes. Each node carries only an integer id, a frame reference, and a timestamp (D-PG-03). Pose data is NOT duplicated here — it lives in the Trajectory payload.

edges.description: Pose graph edges/constraints (D-PG-04…D-PG-07). Each edge is a relative measurement between two nodes.

GraphNode.description: A pose-graph node (D-PG-03). Carries connectivity metadata only — pose data is in the Trajectory payload.

node_id.description: Integer node identifier, ordered by sequence_index within the trajectory.

frame_id.description: UUID referencing a Frame in the import model (bridge, D-TRJ-10).

timestamp_ns.description: Exposure timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.

GraphEdge.description: A relative constraint between two pose-graph nodes (D-PG-04…D-PG-07). The relative transform is T_source_target: maps a point from target frame into source frame. Quaternion order: (x, y, z, w) scalar-last per ADR-007.

edge_id.description: Integer edge identifier, assigned during graph assembly.

source_node_id.description: Reference to GraphNode.node_id (source frame of the constraint).

target_node_id.description: Reference to GraphNode.node_id (target frame of the constraint).

relative_position_xyz.description: Translation component of T_source_target in meters.

relative_rotation_xyzw.description: Rotation component of T_source_target as a unit quaternion in (x, y, z, w) scalar-last order (ADR-007).

information_matrix_6x6.description: 6×6 information matrix (inverse of covariance), flattened row-major in translation-then-rotation ordering (ADR-007, D-PG-05). High value = high confidence = tight constraint.

confidence.description: Informational quality score [0, 1] for human-facing assessment (D-PG-06). The information matrix is the mathematical weight used by the optimizer.

source.description: Which algorithm produced this edge (e.g. 'visual_odometry', 'bow_matcher'). Provenance, not identity (D-PG-07).

configuration_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the effective configuration that produced this edge (D-PG-07). For reproducibility and debugging.
